title: CrossGuns!
description: This Resource Pack makes Crossbows with the Multishot enchantment into Shotguns! NEEDS OPTIFINE!
body:
Ever wanted a more Modern crossbow? Go hunting the american way? well, this texture pack does that! Shotguns! All you need to do is enchant your crossbow with multishot, and blast those zombies to gibblets!
